Senses.Explanation: A fixed arena formula that names the witnessing floor of gods and humans before which an act becomes public. Feiyin Tongrong mounts the seat and splashes water and sand before the host, Zhufeng Zhenxu lifts the incense gathered from beyond the First Voice and cups it out before them, Faxi Yin consents to judge the unfinished case and publishes his notice before them, Poshan Haiming takes his far ancestor's never-ending sutra and sets a gloss on it before them, and Yuan'an Liao, pushed out before the host, climbs the bentwood chair by making the best of the error. Sanyi Mingyu confesses before them the load of broken pots burned at Pingyao and will not cover it over, Xueqiao Yuanxin swings the bow around with the wind before them rather than fail either master, Zhanran Yuancheng reads the sealed notice whose stamps may not be blinked away before them, Fushi Tongxian looks for the undeceived in the host and bares a touch of his style before them, and Zhangxue Tongzui lays out plainly before them the old man of the mountain head who will not squander a thread.
